message.reasoning_content: Card 7: prices +2 next market. I'm poorest, no goods. Others have goods and will benefit. Vote no — but others may pass it. As president, veto is better? Weights 1 each, all voted. If it passed and veto pending... it says post_vote, voted all true, veto_pending false. Likely it passed (others voted yes). Veto to suppress +2 prices hurting me relatively. Veto kills +2 price, good for me.
